Additionally, Brooks highlights opportunities to expand ServiceNow's presence beyond traditional enterprise functions. As military and government organizations modernize, enterprise platforms are increasingly being used to support operational missions, field activities, and more complex organizational workflows. Looking ahead, Brooks believes artificial intelligence, workflow automation, cybersecurity, and enterprise modernization will remain key priorities across defense and national security sectors, creating opportunities for continued technology adoption and innovation. JD Durkin and Brooks also discuss the growing role of AI in military readiness, operational efficiency, and the modernization priorities shaping the future of defense organizations.
